mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines are not followed by negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE increases > 0.5% are not followed by negative 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM are not followed by negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and decrease in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates a misalignment in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The described interaction is not followed by negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 1% is not followed by positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 are not followed by positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 decreases > 0.5% QoQ are not followed by negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases.
